title: clermontia oblongifolia subsp. mauiensis
intro: Clermontia oblongifolia subsp. mauiensis, commonly known as Maui helleri or Heller's Clermontia, is a species of flowering plant endemic to the island of Maui in Hawaii. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Clermontia oblongifolia subsp. mauiensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include phenolic compounds and flavonoids that may have antimicrobial and antiviral properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
